title: What is Artificial Intelligence?
description: This lesson introduces the fundamental concept of Artificial Intelligence—what it is, what it isn't, and where it's used today.
learningObjectives: Distinguish between AI, ML, and DL

content.content: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the simulation of human intelligence in machines. It encompasses everything from rule-based systems to self-learning neural networks.
Machine Learning: A subset of AI where systems learn from data without explicit programming.
Deep Learning: A subset of ML using neural networks with many layers.
Modern AI is powered by transformer architectures and trained on massive datasets. The key insight is that intelligence emerges from scale and pattern recognition.
ChatGPT, self-driving cars, and recommendation systems are all real-world AI applications.
The relationship between AI, ML, and DL is hierarchical: AI ⊃ ML ⊃ DL. Understanding this hierarchy is crucial for navigating the AI landscape.

flashcards.back: AI is the simulation of human intelligence in machines.

flashcards.front: What is the relationship between AI, ML, and DL?
flashcards.back: ML is a subset of AI. DL is a subset of ML.

items.question: Explain the difference between AI, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning in your own words.
items.answer: AI is the broad field of creating intelligent machines. ML is a subset where machines learn from data. DL is a subset of ML using multi-layer neural networks.
items.explanation: Think of AI as the universe, ML as a galaxy within it, and DL as a solar system within that galaxy.
